rawContent: @SenMikeLee What is unacceptable is the fact that you are supporting Trump’s use of force against peaceful protesters for a publicity stunt. @FaceTheNation @margbrennan I think we can all agree that, if indeed the protesters were truly so much of a threat that Barr believed military should be deployed, then no one would ever have allowed Trump to walk that same street! This is tyranny for a publicity stunt! Liars! #BlackLivesMatter
